core.help.commands.body: This overview any time with /help. Set up the household or see the progress: /onboarding. Change the language of fixed texts: /language. Choose the bot's character (e.g. butler): /persona. See and switch what the bot sends on its own: /reminders. As the owner, see what the AI cost in the last 7 and 30 days: /costs. Backups of your data run encrypted via the server command line (lifeagents backup export|restore) — no longer via the chat.

core.update.todo.retry: Tap “Try again”. A second run continues where it stopped and usually fixes this.

core.update.todo.security: Don't do anything else and don't install anything by hand. Please report this via “Report a problem”.
core.update.todo.held: Run lifeagents reconfigure in the terminal and enter the information. Then tap “Update now” on the update card again.

core.wizard.q.telegram_bot_token.label: Telegram bot
core.wizard.q.telegram_bot_token.help:
You chat with your assistant through your own Telegram bot. This is how you get its key (token):

1. In Telegram, search for @BotFather and open the chat.
2. Send /newbot.
3. Choose a display name and a username that ends in “bot”.
4. BotFather answers with the token (like 123456:ABC-DEF…). Paste it here.

The token is checked with Telegram right away.
core.wizard.q.anthropic_api_key.title: Your key for Claude
core.wizard.q.anthropic_api_key.label: Anthropic key
core.wizard.q.anthropic_api_key.help:
Your assistant thinks with Claude by Anthropic. Without this key the bot does not answer.

1. Open console.anthropic.com and sign in.
2. Add credit (“Billing”), then “API Keys” → “Create Key” → copy the key.

Anthropic does not use API data for training. You pay for what you use. The key is checked with Anthropic right away.
core.wizard.q.google_api_key.title: Your key from Google
core.wizard.q.google_api_key.label: Google key
core.wizard.q.google_api_key.help:
Claude does not understand audio. That is why Google's Gemini turns your voice messages into text.

1. Open aistudio.google.com and sign in with your Google account.
2. “Get API key” → “Create API key” → copy the key.
3. Important: turn on billing for the project (paid plan). Only then does Google not use your data for training.

core.wizard.q.domain.help: It is shown in the port sharing entry in the field “MyFRITZ! address”, for example meinrechner.deine-domain.myfritz.net. Then wait about a minute until it is registered.

core.wizard.page.handoff_awake: Finally we ask whether this computer should stay awake so your bot can answer at any time.
core.wizard.confirm.new_area: Your assistant gets its own separate area on this computer
core.wizard.confirm.new_fritzbox: The connection through the two port sharings you created in the FritzBox
core.wizard.confirm.new_tunnel: A tunnel through your Tailscale account, only for Telegram's addresses
core.wizard.confirm.new_bot: Your Telegram bot is pointed at this computer
core.wizard.confirm.keep_programs: Your other programs, including everything already running in Docker
core.wizard.confirm.keep_files: Your files and the protection of your disk
core.wizard.confirm.keep_energy: The energy settings, until you agree at the end
core.wizard.install.title: Your assistant is being set up
core.wizard.install.help: This takes a few minutes. You can leave the window open and do something else.
core.wizard.install.failed_note: Something went wrong at the step “{step}”. Your answers are saved. Try again; if it fails again, send the report to the person who helps you.
core.wizard.reach.needs_login_help: A new page opens. You can sign in there with your Google, Apple or Microsoft account.
core.wizard.reach.needs_machine_auth_hel: Your Tailscale account wants you to approve new devices yourself. Open the list of your devices there and approve this computer.
core.wizard.reach.needs_funnel_title: Allow your computer to receive messages
core.wizard.reach.needs_funnel_help: On the next page, confirm once that messages from outside may reach this computer. Only the addresses for Telegram are open, everything else stays closed.
core.wizard.reach.key_expired_help: Sign this computer in to Tailscale again.
core.wizard.reach.ports_busy_title: The FritzBox route is taken on this computer
core.wizard.reach.ports_busy_help: Another program already uses the route the FritzBox would need. We do not change it, otherwise it would stop working.
core.wizard.reach.ports_busy_note: Use “Through a secure tunnel” instead. You can switch this in the app's menu.
core.wizard.connect.title: Connect to your bot
core.wizard.connect.activating: The tunnel is up. Your bot is now being pointed at it.
core.wizard.connect.not_reaching: Telegram does not reach your computer yet.
core.wizard.connect.open_link: Open the link if you have Telegram on this computer
core.wizard.connect.scan: Scan the code with your phone. Telegram opens your bot.
core.wizard.connect.code_valid: The code is valid for 10 minutes and only shows that you are the owner.
core.wizard.connect.connected_wait: Connected. The bot is being set up for you …
core.wizard.connect.waiting: Waiting for your message to the bot …
core.wizard.connect.preparing: One moment, the code is being prepared.
core.wizard.connect.code_failed: The code for the connection could not be created. Please try again in a moment.
core.wizard.connect.activation_failed: The connection to Telegram could not be set up just now. Try again; if it fails again, send the report to the person who helps you.
core.wizard.connect.key_expiry: Tailscale signs this computer out in {days} days, then Telegram no longer reaches the bot. Turn this off: in Tailscale under “Machines”, at this computer, choose “Disable key expiry”.
core.wizard.webhook.foreign: Your bot still delivers its messages to another service. Close the connection there or create a new bot.
core.wizard.webhook.fritzbox: Telegram is not getting through to your computer right now. In the FritzBox under Internet → Permit Access, check that both port sharings (HTTP server and HTTPS server) are active for this computer. If the Online Monitor says “DS-Lite”, this route does not work; then switch to “Through a secure tunnel” in the app.
core.wizard.webhook.tunnel: Telegram is not getting through to your computer right now. In Tailscale, check that receiving messages from outside (Funnel) is still on for this computer. Then tap “Start” in Telegram again.
core.wizard.domain.verified: Checked: the address points to your internet connection. It is already filled in.
core.wizard.domain.live_ok: Found ✓ The address points to your internet connection.
core.wizard.domain.live_wrong_ip: This address does not point to your internet connection. Check the device name in the FritzBox.
core.wizard.domain.live_pending: Not registered yet. The FritzBox needs about a minute for this.
